import LogLevel, Logger, record from "@std/log.ms"

type Request {
	request String
}

type Payload {
	count Int
	ok Bool
	nested List[Bool?]
	service String
	level Int
	msg String
	time Int
}

export fn emit(logger Logger) Void! {
	child := logger.child_json("{\"request\":\"req-1\"}")?
	fields := Payload(
		count: 9007199254740993,
		ok: true,
		nested: [null, false],
		service: "worker",
		level: 0,
		msg: "spoofed",
		time: 0,
	)
	child.debug("filtered")?
	record(
		logger: child,
		level: LogLevel.Info,
		message: "received \"payload\"\nnext",
		fields,
	)?
	logger.warn("complete")?
}
